## Question 3

:::{.callout-warning}
## Drawing a Random Sample

A class has 55 students, numbered 1 through 55. Use `set.seed(2026)` so that your result can be reproduced, draw a random sample of 10 students with `sample()`, and report the mean of the 10 student numbers with `mean()`.

## Question 4

:::{.callout-warning}
## Classifying Variables

For each of the following variables, state whether it is **qualitative** or **quantitative**, and give its **level of measurement** (nominal, ordinal, interval, or ratio).

1. The blood type of a patient
2. The number of customers served in a day
3. The ranking of a restaurant on a five-star scale
4. The monthly rent of an apartment in New Taipei City
:::
